svg.font-family: 'LP2P Inter', Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: In a field tent with no internet and no cell network, a mix of devices (an old laptop, a rugged tablet, a cracked phone and a field kit box) are thrown together and connected directly over Local Peer-to-Peer.
svg.text: Whatever devices are at hand, connected directly
